## How did you check it?

- [ ] I searched the list: no duplicate (also not under another section)
- [ ] `node scripts/repo-facts.mjs owner/name` shows it is not archived and has a commit or release in the last 12 months
- [ ] The licence is clear, and the entry names it if it limits use (GPL, AGPL, commercial)
- [ ] Papers: `node scripts/arxiv-titles.mjs <id>` or the DOI confirms title, authors and year
- [ ] `node scripts/check-links.mjs` shows no new problem
- [ ] Not a signal seller, paid course without a free part, or referral link
